name: Sherry Lynn
bio: Sherry Lynn is an American voice actress who has played roles in anime, animated television series and video games. She portrayed Sasami Jurai in the Tenchi Muyo! franchise.

credits.title: Tenchi Galaxy
credits.overview: Many years ago, Tenchi Muyo! director Hiroshi Negishi wrote a draft for a would-be sequel to his beloved TV series. It has never seen the light of day...until now. credits.overview: Riley, now 12, who is hanging out with her parents at home when potential trouble comes knocking. Mom's and Dad's Emotions find themselves forced to deal with Riley going on her first "date."

credits.title: Inside Out
credits.overview: When 11-year-old Riley moves to a new city, her Emotions team up to help her through the transition. Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust and Sadness work together, but when Joy and Sadness get lost, they must journey through unfamiliar places to get back home.

But when circumstances separate Buzz and Woody from their owner, the duo eventually learns to put aside their differences.
